scientific_limitations: Applies to the exponential-quadratic copula family and the stationary Markov kernels built from it; not a universal copula mixing bound. Exact constants are root-defined, decimal values approximate; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp universal spectral and uniform-mixing envelopes for an exponential-quadratic copula
